$comment: The fixed legitimate payment stream (EXPERIMENTS X1 'Legit workload'; BUILD.md M7 'Legit stream'). One fixture shared by the TypeScript harness and the Foundry cards (X1 lane mirrors it in contracts/test/cards). Replayed at the start of every card, then the attack fires. New honest payees appear mid-run: two attested PROVEN by the attestor, one cold start within explorePerTxCap. Addresses are keccak256(label) low 20 bytes, so both readers use the same payees. payeeClass: listed = owner-listed shop, attested = the attestor issues PROVEN, cold = no history (no attestation). Metric 2 counts blocked and needed-approval separately; legitProvenBlocked counts blocked payments whose payeeClass is listed or attested.
